items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: I have a sneaky suspicion that that's how Fats happened to propose to me about coming with him.

ctx.x: Fats wasn't working all that steady; was he?
He worked fairly well. I don't mean that he wasn't a good

musician, because Fats was a wonderful musician too, but Fats was more of a jive guy. Louie Armstrong was a guy that you would, as a musician, you would admire--he would be the most that you would want to be like. He was a great influence on my life.
